systems.owner: National Registration Bureau; K5.4 billion allocated in the 2025/26 financial year for the first two phases of a K17.8 billion cost, with Treasury and partners approached for the rest
systems.tiers: seven phases across 25 districts, government primary schools as registration centres staffed by trained teachers and NRB staff; about 4.6 million unregistered children under 16 targeted
about 3.8 million children registered since 2015 and over 12.8 million national IDs issued

note: About a phased registration campaign, which the typology classes as outreach, and counts of children registered; nothing on how local offices make the record.
